ns2:course.label: Thinking About Physics
ns2:course.description: Designed for students who want to prepare for PHYS 211 by improving their conceptual and problem solving skills. Shows how to analyze physical situations, describe them mathematically, and understand the meaning of the solutions. Examples will be drawn from material that will be covered in PHYS 211. PHYS 100 and PHYS 211 may be taken concurrently. Approval of the department is required to register. Prerequisite: Credit or concurrent registration in MATH 220 or MATH 221.
